features.name: white_king_safety_score
features.description: Composite safety indicator for white king position based on overlap, position, and non-check status.
features.expected_model_benefit: Smooth linear projection summarizing white king safety; useful for SVM margin separation.

features.name: black_king_threat_score
features.description: Aggregate threat indicators against black king (blocks, near-edge, square attacks).
features.expected_model_benefit: Continuous severity summing multiple black-king vulnerability flags for linear margin.

features.name: white_attack_pressure
features.description: Sum of white piece attacking/threatening indicators on key squares.
features.expected_model_benefit: Provides linear separation in attack strength; useful for SVM hyperplane.

features.name: pawn_promotion_pressure
features.description: Indicators related to pawn near promotion squares for both sides.
features.expected_model_benefit: Aggregated pawn-race severity; smooth continuous input for linear models.

features.name: katri_ordinal
features.description: Ordinal encoding of katri (king-attack tri-state): n=0, w=1, b=-1.
features.expected_model_benefit: Compact ordinal signed projection of 3-level categorical for linear margin.

features.name: wtoeg_signed
features.description: Signed encoding of wtoeg: n=0, t=1 indicating tempo/edge status.
features.expected_model_benefit: Direct linear contribution for tempo distinction.

features.name: dwipd_signed
features.description: Signed encoding of dwipd (distance/win-in-position depth): l=0, g=1.
features.expected_model_benefit: Single-direction linear input separating depth states.

features.name: rare_critical_flags
features.description: Sum of rare but potentially decisive flags (head check, stalemate, threatening skewer, knight skewer-check, mate-in-one chain).
features.expected_model_benefit: Captures rare high-impact endgame conditions in single linear-friendly score.

features.name: position_complexity_score
features.description: Inverse-simplicity composite: high when position is complex (simpl=f) and context-dependent.
features.expected_model_benefit: Smooth signed complexity indicator complementing other features in linear projection.

features.name: white_advantage_ratio
features.description: Ratio of white-favorable flags over total active flags involving white and black, smoothed.
features.expected_model_benefit: Normalized continuous score ideal for linear SVM kernel-free margin.

features.name: defensive_resource_score
features.description: Sum of defensive resources available (responses for king-defender, opposition, residual squares).
features.expected_model_benefit: Continuous defensive-resource counter for SVM linear boundary.

features.name: tactical_imbalance_judgment
features.description: Semantic judgment of tactical imbalance: scaled difference between aggregate white attacking pressure and aggregate black defensive/king-safety conditions normalized to [-1,1].
features.expected_model_benefit: Provides a smooth signed margin-like input estimating tactical asymmetry useful for linear SVM.
